title: Disney Mickey Mouse Head Silhouette Etched Libbey Glass 10 oz Coffee Cup Mug
descriptionText:
Used, some faded Mickey heads. 

This collectible Disney mug features a classic silhouette of Mickey Mouse's head, etched onto a 10 oz coffee cup. Made by Libbey Glass, this mug is a perfect addition to any Disney fan's collection. The cup is made of high-quality glass and features a sturdy handle for easy gripping. The mug is perfect for enjoying your favorite hot beverage or simply for display. Add this unique piece to your collection today!
